parts.zh: W: 杰克，坐下来听我说
M: 我们为什么不干脆集中精力在国内扩大业务呢？
W: 当然，我们应该守住在这里的地位
M: 没错，但这里很安全
W: 我同意。所以我才建议出口
W: 好吧。现在确实会产生额外费用
M: 你有多大把握我们能在国外市场取得成功？
W: 嗯，这才是棘手的问题

items.stem: What does the woman intend to do?

choices.text: Persuade the man to join her company.
choices.zh: 说服男士加入她的公司。

choices.text: Employ the most up-to-date technology.
choices.zh: 采用最新的技术。

choices.text: Export bikes to foreign markets.
choices.zh: 将自行车出口到国外市场。

choices.text: Expand their domestic business.
choices.zh: 拓展他们的国内业务。

items.stem: Why does the man think it's safe to focus on the home market?

choices.text: The state subsidizes small and medium enterprises.
choices.zh: 国家为中小企业提供补贴。

choices.text: The government has control over bicycle imports.
choices.zh: 政府对自行车进口进行管控。

choices.text: They can compete with the best domestic manufacturers.
choices.zh: 他们可以与国内最好的制造商竞争。

choices.text: They have a cost advantage and can charge higher prices.
choices.zh: 他们拥有成本优势并能够收取更高的价格。

items.stem: What is the man's concern about selling bikes abroad?

choices.text: Extra costs might eat up their profits abroad.
choices.zh: 额外成本可能会吃掉他们在国外的利润。

choices.text: More workers will be needed to do packaging.
choices.zh: 需要更多工人来做包装工作。

choices.text: They might lose to foreign bike manufacturers.
choices.zh: 他们可能会输给国外的自行车制造商。

choices.text: It is very difficult to find suitable local agents.
choices.zh: 很难找到合适的当地代理商。

items.stem: What do the speakers agree to do?

choices.text: Report to the management.
choices.zh: 向管理层汇报。

choices.text: Attract foreign investments.
choices.zh: 吸引外国投资。

choices.text: Conduct a feasibility study.
choices.zh: 进行可行性研究。

choices.text: Consult financial experts.
choices.zh: 咨询金融专家。

items.stem: What do we usually refer to when we talk about energy according to the man?

choices.text: Coal burnt daily for the comfort of our homes.
choices.zh: 每天为我们家庭的舒适而燃烧的煤炭。

choices.text: Anything that can be used to produce power.
choices.zh: 任何可以用来产生动力的东西。

choices.text: Fuel refined from oil extracted from underground.
choices.zh: 从地下开采的石油中提炼出的燃料。

choices.text: Electricity that keeps all kinds of machines running.
choices.zh: 使各种机器运转的电力。

items.stem: What do most experts agree on according to the man?

choices.text: Oil will soon be replaced by alternative energy sources.
choices.zh: 石油将很快被替代能源所取代。

choices.text: Oil reserves in the world will be exhausted in a decade.
choices.zh: 世界上的石油储备将在十年内耗尽。

choices.text: Oil consumption has given rise to many global problems.
choices.zh: 石油消费已经引发了许多全球性问题。

choices.text: Oil production will begin to decline worldwide by 2025.
choices.zh: 到2025年,全球石油产量将开始下降。

items.stem: What does the man think we should do now?

choices.text: Minimize the use of fossil fuels.
choices.zh: 尽量减少化石燃料的使用。

choices.text: Start developing alternative fuels.
choices.zh: 开始开发替代燃料。

choices.text: Find the real cause for global warming.
choices.zh: 找出全球变暖的真正原因。

choices.text: Take steps to reduce the greenhouse effect.
choices.zh: 采取措施减少温室效应。

items.stem: How do fossil fuels affect the environment?

choices.text: They release harmful substances when they are burned.
choices.zh: 它们在燃烧时释放有害物质。

choices.text: They dissolve in the water and cause a waste of water.
choices.zh: 它们溶解在水中并造成水资源的浪费。

choices.text: They release poisonous gas and lead to pollution.
choices.zh: 它们释放有毒气体并导致污染。

choices.text: They are burned inefficiently resulting in a waste of resources.
choices.zh: 它们燃烧效率低下,导致资源浪费。

items.stem: What is said to make a good department store buyer?

choices.text: The ability to predict fashion trends.
choices.zh: 预测时尚趋势的能力。

choices.text: A refined taste for artistic works.
choices.zh: 对艺术作品的高雅品味。

choices.text: Years of practical experience.
choices.zh: 多年的实践经验。

choices.text: Strict professional training.
choices.zh: 严格的专业培训。

items.stem: What does Karen's job involve?

choices.text: Promoting all kinds of American hand-made specialties.
choices.zh: 推广各种美国手工制品特产。

choices.text: Strengthening cooperation with foreign governments.
choices.zh: 加强与外国政府的合作。

choices.text: Conducting trade in art works with dealers overseas.
choices.zh: 与海外经销商进行艺术品贸易。

choices.text: Purchasing handicrafts from all over the world.
choices.zh: 从世界各地采购手工艺品。

items.stem: Why does Karen think she has got the best job?

choices.text: She has access to fashionable things.
choices.zh: 她能接触到时尚的东西。

choices.text: She is doing what she enjoys doing.
choices.zh: 她正在做她喜欢做的事情。

choices.text: She can enjoy life on a modest salary.
choices.zh: 她可以靠微薄的薪水享受生活。

choices.text: She is free to do whatever she wants.
choices.zh: 她可以自由地做任何她想做的事。

items.stem: What did Mark think he should start doing?

choices.text: Join in neighborhood patrols.
choices.zh: 加入社区巡逻。

choices.text: Get involved in his community.
choices.zh: 参与到他的社区中去。

choices.text: Voice his complaints to the city council.
choices.zh: 向市议会表达他的抱怨。

choices.text: Make suggestions to the local authorities.
choices.zh: 向地方当局提出建议。

items.stem: What was being discussed when Mark arrived at the neighborhood meeting?

choices.text: Deterioration in the quality of life.
choices.zh: 生活质量的恶化。

choices.text: Increase of police patrols at night.
choices.zh: 增加夜间警察巡逻。

choices.text: Renovation of the vacant buildings.
choices.zh: 翻修空置建筑。

choices.text: Violation of community regulations.
choices.zh: 违反社区规定。

items.stem: What did Mark think of the community's problems?

choices.text: They may take a long time to solve.
choices.zh: 它们可能需要很长时间才能解决。

choices.text: They need assistance from the city.
choices.zh: 它们需要市里的援助。

choices.text: They have to be dealt with one by one.
choices.zh: 它们必须逐一处理。

choices.text: They are too big for individual efforts.
choices.zh: 它们对于个人的努力来说太大了。

items.stem: Why did Mark smile on his ride home?

choices.text: He had got some groceries at a big discount.
choices.zh: 他以很大的折扣买到了一些杂货。

choices.text: He had read a funny poster near his seat.
choices.zh: 他在座位附近看到了一张有趣的海报。

choices.text: He had done a small deed of kindness.
choices.zh: 他做了一件小小的善事。

choices.text: He had caught the bus just in time.
choices.zh: 他及时赶上了公共汽车。

items.stem: What is the talk mainly about?

choices.text: The difficulties of industrialization in North America.
choices.zh: 北美工业化的困难。

choices.text: The influence of industrialization on people's life.
choices.zh: 工业化对人们生活的影响。

choices.text: The negative effect of industrialization in North America.
choices.zh: 工业化在北美的负面影响。

choices.text: Improved ways of organizing the manufacturing of goods.
choices.zh: 改进商品制造组织方式的方法。

items.stem: Why does the speaker mention the shoe industry?

choices.text: To provide an example of how entrepreneurs increased output by using an extended work system.
choices.zh: 为了举例说明企业家如何通过使用扩展工作系统来增加产量。

choices.text: To provide an example of how entrepreneurs used technological improvements to increase output.
choices.zh: 为了举例说明企业家如何利用技术改进来增加产量。

choices.text: To provide an example of how rural workers responded to shoe bosses.
choices.zh: 为了举例说明农村工人如何回应制鞋业老板。

choices.text: To provide an example of how changes in the work system improved the quality of shoes.
choices.zh: 为了举例说明工作系统的变革如何提高鞋子的质量。

items.stem: According to the talk, how did later mills differ from the mill built by Oliver Evans?

choices.text: They were located away from large cities.
choices.zh: 它们位于远离大城市的地方。

choices.text: They used new technology to produce power.
choices.zh: 它们使用新技术来产生动力。

choices.text: They did not allow flour to cool before it was placed in barrels.
choices.zh: 它们不让面粉在装桶前冷却。

choices.text: They combined technology with the work system.
choices.zh: 它们将技术与工作系统相结合。

items.stem: Which of the following is mentioned as a result of improvements in factory machinery?

choices.text: It became easier for factory owners to find workers and customers.
choices.zh: 工厂主更容易找到工人和顾客。

choices.text: Manufacturers had to employ more highly skilled workers.
choices.zh: 制造商不得不雇用更多高技能工人。

choices.text: The amount of power required for factories' operation was reduced.
choices.zh: 工厂运营所需的动力量减少了。

choices.text: Factories could operate more than one engine at a time.
choices.zh: 工厂可以同时操作多台发动机。

items.stem: According to the talk, what was a highly significant factor in the development of realist and naturalist literature?

choices.text: The Civil War.
choices.zh: 内战。

choices.text: An economic depression.
choices.zh: 经济萧条。

choices.text: A recognition that romanticism was unpopular.
choices.zh: 认识到浪漫主义不受欢迎。

choices.text: An increased interest in the study of common speech.
choices.zh: 对日常口语研究的兴趣增加。

items.stem: Why is Mark Twain considered as a very important literary figure?

choices.text: Because he wrote humorous stories and novels.
choices.zh: 因为他写了幽默的故事和小说。

choices.text: Because he rejected romanticism as a literary approach.
choices.zh: 因为他拒绝浪漫主义作为一种文学手法。

choices.text: Because he was the first realist writer in the United States.
choices.zh: 因为他是美国第一位现实主义作家。

choices.text: Because he influenced American prose style through his use of common speech.
choices.zh: 因为他通过使用日常口语影响了美国散文风格。

items.stem: What can we learn about Theodore Dreiser, according to the talk?

choices.text: He mainly wrote about historical subjects such as the Civil War.
choices.zh: 他主要写关于内战等历史题材的作品。

choices.text: His novels often contained elements of humor.
choices.zh: 他的小说常常包含幽默元素。

choices.text: He viewed himself more as a social observer than as a literary artist.
choices.zh: 他认为自己更像是一个社会观察者而非文学艺术家。

choices.text: He believed writers should emphasize the positive aspects of life.
choices.zh: 他认为作家应该强调生活的积极方面。

items.stem: What does Dr. Hudson say regarding the vast majority of species in Earth's history at the beginning of the lecture?

choices.text: They have remained basically unchanged from their original forms.
choices.zh: 它们基本保持着原始形态没有改变。

choices.text: They have been able to adapt to ecological changes.
choices.zh: 它们能够适应生态变化。

choices.text: They have caused rapid change in the environment.
choices.zh: 它们导致了环境的快速变化。

choices.text: They are no longer in existence.
choices.zh: 它们已不复存在。

items.stem: What does the evidence from fossils suggest?

choices.text: Extinction of species has occurred from time to time throughout Earth's history.
choices.zh: 物种灭绝在地球历史上不时发生。

choices.text: Extinctions on Earth have generally been massive.
choices.zh: 地球上的物种灭绝通常是大规模的。

choices.text: There has been only one mass extinction in Earth's history.
choices.zh: 地球历史上只发生过一次大灭绝。

choices.text: Dinosaurs became extinct much earlier than scientists originally believed.
choices.zh: 恐龙灭绝的时间比科学家最初认为的要早得多。

items.stem: What can we learn about the "interesting and controversial" finding?

choices.text: Extinctions during the past 25 million years have tended to be more intense every 2.6 million years.
choices.zh: 过去2500万年间的物种灭绝往往每隔260万年就会更加剧烈。

choices.text: The theory that the periodic extinction had something to do with the Earth's movement is only a speculation.
choices.zh: 周期性灭绝与地球运动有关的理论只是一种推测。

choices.text: This finding was already confirmed by the most prestigious scientists in the world.
choices.zh: 这一发现已经得到世界上最权威科学家的证实。

choices.text: A species' survival totally depends on its ability or inability to adapt.
choices.zh: 物种的存亡完全取决于其适应或不适应的能力。
